opportunities.title: Hackers Set French Supermarket Fridges to 50°C: When IoT Patch Cadence Becomes a Food Safety Crisis
opportunities.why_now: Attackers hijacked Danfoss refrigeration controllers to spoil food across European supermarkets, turning an unpatched OT device into a public health incident.
opportunities.angle: Deep-dive breakdown of the Danfoss exploit chain, why OT/IoT patch cycles lag years behind IT, and what grocery chains should have patched months ago

opportunities.title: GitLab's CVSS 10.0 Regex RCE: The Patch You Need Before Monday Standup
opportunities.why_now: GitLab just shipped a fix for an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw rated maximum severity, hitting self-hosted instances everywhere.
opportunities.angle: Rapid-patch advisory post with exploit mechanics, affected versions, and a blunt 'patch now' checklist

opportunities.title: SonicWall Patched It, Attackers Didn't Care: 135 Exploit Attempts Hit the 'Fixed' SMA Flaw
opportunities.why_now: A maximum-severity SSRF in SonicWall SMA 1000 is being actively exploited even after a patch landed, proving patching alone isn't winning the race.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence postmortem on why fixed CVEs keep getting hammered, with a timeline of disclosure-to-exploitation

opportunities.title: The $86M Ledger Heist Wasn't a Software Bug — It Was a Chip Someone Soldered In
opportunities.why_now: Ledger confirmed a hardware implant in signer devices sold via a third-party retailer caused a massive crypto theft, reviving supply-chain hardware tampering fears.
opportunities.angle: Supply-chain threat actor explainer: how hardware implants bypass every software security control, and what buying 'certified' hardware actually means now

opportunities.title: The Incident Responder Who Became the Suspect: Inside the ShinyHunters FBI-Hack Arrest
opportunities.why_now: A ransomware negotiator/incident response exec was arrested on extortion charges tied to the ShinyHunters FBI hacking probe, a stunning insider-threat twist in the breach-response industry itself.
opportunities.angle: Narrative threat-actor profile on the irony of trusted IR/negotiation insiders turning rogue, with implications for vetting breach-response vendors
